$comment: Every direct dependency, with why we need it (ADR 0006). `bun run check` fails if package.json has a package that isn't listed here, or this lists one package.json doesn't have. `bun run deps:health` runs ADR 0006's health checks on added or changed packages; `exceptions` allows a named failing check (scorecard, recent-release, maintainers, install-scripts, license) and says why. Changing this file needs a code owner's approval.
